prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision that occurred at an intersection. Presenting complaints included pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion of the affected knee, with difficulty bearing weight in the first days after the incident. Initial examination showed joint effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury to the medial collateral ligament with associated contusion.

Conservative management was selected. Treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focused on restoring range of motion, quadriceps and hamstring strengthening, and gait retraining, supplemented by cryotherapy, anti-inflammatory medication, and a temporary hinged knee brace. Over a course of 17 visits, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain scores, swelling, and functional mobility.

At the most recent visit, the patient was ambulating without assistive devices, reported minimal residual discomfort with stairs, and had regained near-full range of motion. Mild intermittent stiffness persists with prolonged sitting. Continued home exercise is recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
